messages:
Mia Chen: quick heads up — I opened PR #8342 to add model-routing heuristics for small-batch low-latency requests. blocking merge until architecture + security give a quick safety note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8342

Ravi Patel: Looking. main concerns? cross-tenant KV reuse or fallback behaviour?

Mia Chen: primary is the fallback behavior we implemented for out-of-capacity GPUs (it routes to quantized variant). also a small change to the KV-prefixing behavior. added an excerpt in the PR description.

Oliver Grant: pinged. can you paste the canary plan here? I want to see latency delta and SLO checks. tiny note: any changes to prefixing might affect cache hit semantics for multi-tenant keys.

Mia Chen: sure — canary plan snippet:

```
canary: 5% traffic for 24h
metrics: p50/p95 latency, token cost per request, cache-hit-rate per tenant
rollback: immediate if p95 > baseline + 40ms or cache-hit-rate drops > 10%
```

Mia Chen: RFC link (design): https://rfc.redwood.ai/r/612-model-routing-fallbacks — there's a section about cache isolation and tenant-safe prefixes.

Kat Morales: quick security note: make sure the prefixing uses the tenant ID + model-version and we never fall back to a model that uses a different data residency. otherwise LGTM. also add a unit-test for prefix collision.

Ravi Patel: reading the RFC now. small nit in PR: the new prefix code sets `prefix = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", model, key)` — should be `tenant/model/key`. please update.

Mia Chen: good catch — will update. also adding a test to verify no cross-tenant key reuse.

deploy-bot: CI passed (unit + integration). staging e2e queued. :rocket:

Oliver Grant: once you add the tenant prefix and the test, I can do a quick perf check. also paste the perf numbers from your local runs (p50/p95 and CPU/GPU util).

Mia Chen: local numbers attached to PR comment — p50 ~ 18ms, p95 ~ 55ms on A10. CPU negligible. I'll rerun with only tenant-prefixed cache.

Kat Morales: also add a short blurb in the RFC referencing the exact rollout constraints (the rollback thresholds above). makes QA easier.

Ravi Patel: if you want speed, I can review the change tonight. otherwise I can do it tomorrow morning.

Mia Chen: thanks — if you can take a look tonight that'd be amazing. tagging @Oliver for perf once tenant prefix change is pushed.

Oliver Grant: noted. i'll watch for the update and run a small perf job in staging after you push.

Mia Chen: pushed tenant prefix fix + test. updated PR description with exact RFC section link (sec 3.2). marking PR as `awaiting-arch` and adding canary window.

Ravi Patel: reviewing now. small comment inline about a nil-check in the prefix builder.

Mia Chen: fixed the nil-check. thanks.

Oliver Grant: ran perf on staging canary branch — p50 19ms, p95 58ms, cache-hit-rate unchanged. prefixed keys look good. I'm fine with architecture sign-off pending Kat's security ack.

Kat Morales: security acked. added a comment about the unit-test naming and that the rollback thresholds should be part of the runbook.

Mia Chen: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll add runbook note and request final merge window for tomorrow morning. merging gated on arch+security ack which we now have. :tada:

deploy-bot: merged by automation at 3445009620 (merge window: 09:00 UTC).
